title: NormalizedUsageRecord
description: The unified record every provider adapter emits. MISSING-VALUE CONTRACT: a token field is number|null. null means 'this source does not report it'; 0 means 'it reported zero'. Analytics never coerce null to 0.

id.description: Stable dedup key: hash(source, session, request||timestamp, model, seq).

date.description: Resolved in the capture timezone at ingest, then stored.

provider.description: Canonical vendor slug derived from the model name. 'unknown' when it cannot be determined — never a guess.

gateway.description: Routing layer (proxy/router) that served the request. NOT the vendor.

model.description: Raw model identifier from the source, preserved verbatim.

client.description: Tool that made the call: claude-code | codex | cline | cursor | ...

interface.description: Derived ONLY from an explicit surface field. Never inferred from the model or provider. 'Unknown' when there was no signal.

input_tokens.description: FRESH prompt tokens, EXCLUDING cache read and cache write. Adapters for OpenAI-convention sources must subtract cached_input_tokens.

cache_read_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from a prompt cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Prompt tokens written into a prompt cache.

cache_refresh_tokens.description: SUBSET of cache_write_tokens (long-TTL / refreshed writes). Never added into a total again.

reasoning_tokens.description: SUBSET of output_tokens (thinking / reasoning). Never added into a total again.

total_tokens.description: DERIVED: input + cache_read + cache_write + output. Never trusted from the source.

total_is_partial.description: True when at least one billable field was not available.

project.description: Usually the basename of the working directory.

estimated_cost.description: null when the model has no configured price. NEVER 0 as a stand-in for unknown.

cost_basis.description: 'measured' = the source actually billed it; 'estimated' = computed from the price table.

measurement.description: primary = authoritative per-request usage, counted in totals. overlay = a gateway's view of traffic already counted elsewhere, excluded from totals by default. activity = no token accounting at all.

metadata.description: Source-specific. Never interpreted by analytics. Put audit trails here (event counts, reconstruction segments, cwd, versions).
